text: Directable speech synthesis, character performances, dubbing and multilingual dialogue.
An example of the canvas in Hanzo Design. Generation runs on Hanzo Cloud.
Direct nuances in tone: breath control, hesitation, whispers, intense delivery, irony, and pitch contour through natural language instructions.
Preserves vocal identity, formant fingerprint and emotional timbre across languages and regional dialects.
Phoneme timing alignment matched to video mouth shapes and facial cadence for localization.
Every synthesized voice carries an imperceptible cryptographic watermark, and its provenance is logged.
Dub episodic television and movies into international languages while retaining the original actor’s voice characteristics.
Deliver thousands of hours of high-performance character dialogue in video games without recording bottlenecks.
Cast an entire ensemble of distinct characters from a single manuscript with consistent chapter-to-chapter character voices.
